$comment: The IDENTITY file for the logo subject. Written on day one, while there is only one brand and the
value is constant — it costs one line now and a migration across every record and every shipped
This is the GENERATOR'S INPUT, not its output. Colour is SOLVED, not picked: the generator reads
hue / saturation / contrastFloor and emits tints that clear the floor, recording worstContrast so
the guarantee is auditable. A hand-edited hex silently breaks it — change the inputs and re-run.
Not to be confused with ../../../../theme/tokens.json, which holds the SITE tokens. This file holds
the BRAND identity. Both names are correct; they belong to two different systems.
$status: No master exists in ../../svg/ yet. logoId is reserved now so the promote record and the drift check have a stable key to compare against from the first promotion onward. It is never reused for a different mark — a redesign bumps logoVersion; a different brand takes a new logoId.
$colour: Null until THE ONE RULE is written (see README.md). The rule decides whether colour is solved against a contrast floor at all — one reference brand varies the PLATE behind a fixed mark, another solves every tint against a 3.0:1 floor. Opposite layouts, both correct, because each follows from its own rule. Filling these in before the rule exists would be copying another project's layout and hoping.
